name: trz-bg
description: Bulgarian payroll (ТРЗ) compliance tooling for Claude Code. One plugin: an audit skill for payroll registers, payslips, employment contracts and work schedules, with a dated reference file for every rate.

plugins.name: trz-expert
plugins.description: Bulgarian payroll (ТРЗ) audit: checks a payroll register, payslip, employment contract or work schedule against the Labour Code (КТ), the Social Security Code (КСО), the income tax act (ЗДДФЛ) and the wage-structure ordinance (НСОРЗ). No rate from memory — every figure comes from a dated, status-marked reference file.
